title: Fellowships
about: Graduate fellowships at The American University in Cairo for fall 2027 entry. Fellowship cycle 1 runs from 22 December 2026 to 17 January 2027; cycle 2 runs in April-May 2027. The admission application must be submitted two weeks before.
requirements: Graduate admission application must be submitted at least two weeks before the fellowship deadline
Fall 2027 graduate admission deadlines: 15 December 2026 (early) and 1 April 2027 (regular)
